spec.description: Per-Mac view of pulseki metrics. Switch machines with the Instance dropdown.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - (node_memory_free_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"} + node_memory_inactive_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"} + node_memory_purgeable_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"}) / node_memory_total_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance"})
100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance", fstype!="devfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance", fstype!="devfs"})
